interpretation_guardrails: A failed readout probe does not show that the S1/S2 representation is invalid.
A residual-head gain does not identify a specific mechanism defect in the frozen model.
Single-seed differences are resource-decision evidence, not statistical significance.
Validation labels have already been used for model selection in earlier rounds; they are not an independent final confirmation set.
decision_rule.main_metric: AP_L/AP_N at fixed epoch 8 (never the best-Validation checkpoint)

rules.INCOMPLETE: a correctness/checkpoint/data-isolation gate failed, an arm did not complete the fixed 8 epochs and all four evaluation epochs, a formal result is missing, or the GPU budget was exhausted
rules.NONLINEAR_EXTRA_SIGNAL: READOUT_SIGNAL holds AND D_NL = AP_N(epoch8) - AP_L(epoch8) >= +0.003
rules.NO_FAST_READOUT_SIGNAL: both arms complete; D_L <= 0 and D_N <= 0 (no directional readout gain)
rules.READOUT_SIGNAL: both arms complete; at least one head has D = AP_head(epoch8) - AP0 >= +0.005 AND >= 64 of 127 scorable tasks improved
rules.WEAK_OR_MIXED: both arms complete; max(D_L, D_N) > 0 but READOUT_SIGNAL does not hold

decision_rule.statistical_claim: none; these are resource-decision labels only
